item.title: Quantum Optics Jena’s ELVIS System Passes Independent Security Testing for Quantum Communication
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Quantum Optics Jena GmbH today announced that its ELVIS system has become the world’s first quantum communication system to resist real-world quantum hacking tricks, passing the most-rigorous round of independent security testing to date. The ELVIS system was subject to six tests, under ISO/IEC 23837, conducted over three months by […]
